blocks.text: Simple lipids fatty acids ke mukhtalif alcohols ke saath esters hain. Alcohol ki qism ke lihaz se inhein sub-classes (chhoti qismon) mein baanta jata hai: fats (charbi), oils (teil) aur waxes (mom).

Animal fats (jaanwaron ki charbi) aur vegetable oils (paudon ke teil) glycerol ke aik molecule aur teen fatty acids se bane esters hain; inhein triglycerides kehte hain (Figure 27.10). Teeno fatty acids aik jaise bhi ho sakte hain aur mukhtalif bhi. Yeh structure inhein energy store karne wale behtareen molecules banati hai; yeh jism ko insulation (garmi rokne wali teh), organs (aaza) ki protection (hifazat) aur fat-soluble (charbi mein ghulne wale) vitamins bhi deti hai.

Saturated fatty acids (jin mein sirf single bonds hon) aise lipids banate hain jo room temperature (kamre ke temperature) par solid (thos) hon; inhein fats kehte hain. Oils mein unsaturated fatty acids hote hain jin mein aik ya zyada double bonds hon.

Fatty acid chains hydrophobic hain, is liye fats paani mein nahi ghulte lekin organic solvents mein ghul jate hain. Jism mein isi property ki wajah se yeh jild ke neeche insulation ki tahein aur kidneys (gurdon) jaise organs ke gird cushion (gaddi) banate hain, jo temperature control rakhne aur protection (hifazat) mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Glycerol, teen carbon ki chain jis par teen OH groups hain, aur teen fatty acids, har aik lambi zigzag carbon chain jis ke end par COOH group hai. Teer triglyceride tak jata hai: glycerol ki har oxygen aik chain ke C=O carbon se juri hai, 'fatty acid residue'.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.10: Glycerol aur fatty acids mil kar triglycerides banate hain (kitab ki Figure 27.10 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Glycerol ke teen OH groups mein se har aik aik fatty acid ke COOH se ester bond banata hai; har bond par aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai, yani triglyceride bante hue teen H₂O nikalte hain. Product mein har chain 'fatty acid residue' (bacha hua hissa) kehlati hai kyun ke us ka OH nikal chuka hai.

Zyada tar waxes lambi fatty acid chains aur lambi chain wale alcohols ke esters hain. Dono chains non-polar aur hydrophobic (paani ko door karne wali) hain. Isi wajah se waxes protective coating (hifazati teh) bana kar barrier (rukawat) ka kaam karte hain aur paani ko surface (satah) par chipakne nahi dete. Nature (qudrat) mein misalein: shehed ki makhi ka mom (beeswax), whale ke sar ka teil, kuch aquatic (paani mein rehne wale) parindon ke par aur paudon ka mom. Pharmaceutical (dawaiyan banane wali), cosmetic aur doosri industries mein inhein lotions, ointments (marham) aur polish banane mein bohat use kiya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab beeswax ka ester CH₃–(CH₂)₃₄–CO–O–(CH₂)₃₅–CH₃ chhapti hai; yeh 72 carbon wala ester hai jo bohat lamba hai. Beeswax ke esters mein taqreeban 40 se 52 carbon hote hain; aam ahem ester myricyl palmitate, CH₃(CH₂)₁₄COO(CH₂)₂₉CH₃, hai (oopar likha gaya).

blocks.prompt: Room temperature par olive oil (zaitoon ka teil) liquid (maaye) aur makhan solid (thos) kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Zaitoon ke teil ke triglycerides mein zyada tar unsaturated fatty acids hain jin ke C=C bonds chains ko mor dete hain, is liye molecules qareeb qareeb nahi jam sakte; makhan mein zyada saturated fatty acids hain jin ki seedhi chains qareeb jam jati hain.

items: Simple lipids: fatty acids aur alcohols ke esters (fats, oils, waxes).
Triglycerides: glycerol + 3 fatty acids; fats (saturated, solid), oils (unsaturated, liquid).
Waxes: lambi chain ka fatty acid + lambi chain ka alcohol; paani se bachane wali teh.
